# Lay-n-Go

> Lay-n-Go makes the patented drawstring activity mat that doubles as cleanup, storage, and carryall — for cosmetics, play, travel, pets, and tactical gear. Pull the cord and the mat cinches shut in seconds.

## Collections

- [Cosmetic bags](/collections/cosmetic-bags): Cosmo lay-flat makeup bags in three sizes.
- [Play](/collections/play): Activity play mats that cinch into a carry bag.
- [Technology](/collections/technology): Tech and travel organizers.
